target_user: U.S. consumers blocked by an AI support bot
trigger: The bot loops or loses context during human escalation
reach_proxy: Recent consumer-service surveys reported frequent AI support use and escalation friction
decision: Rejected as first product after substitute and integration tests

target_user: Consumers who just clicked shared or paid a suspected scam
trigger: The first minutes after suspected compromise
reach_proxy: High-frequency scam exposure and large official loss reports
decision: Deferred because trust burden is high and strong free official routes exist

target_user: Households receiving insurance school government or property notices
trigger: The reader understands the words but not required actions or dates
reach_proxy: Applies across common adult administrative tasks
decision: Rejected as too broad and too close to general AI document help

target_user: Older users and adult children helping remotely
trigger: An unfamiliar phone screen creates fear of a wrong tap
reach_proxy: Large older-adult smartphone base with reported design and trust gaps
decision: Rejected as readily approximated by multimodal AI and risky in sensitive screens

trigger: A deadline or required item is buried across email apps PDFs or paper
reach_proxy: Large family base and persistent email use
decision: Deferred because direct supply is crowded and child privacy adds risk

trigger: Existing food and the next shopping list do not connect
decision: Rejected because substitutes are mature and AI is mainly a feature upgrade

trigger: A trial converts a price rises or a charge continues after cancellation
reach_proxy: Commercial surveys report widespread trial and cancellation friction
decision: Reframed as a template rather than a standalone first product

target_user: Online shoppers facing a refused or incomplete refund
trigger: Orders chats tracking and photos must be assembled
reach_proxy: Online shopping is broad and shopping scams are frequently reported
decision: Reframed as a possible workflow template

candidate: Telecom or utility bill dispute helper
target_user: Households seeing a new fee or unexplained plan change
trigger: A bill changes and support cannot explain it
decision: Useful signal that later contributed to the narrower BillFit direction

candidate: Social seller or ad risk check
target_user: Buyers considering payment from a social-platform ad
trigger: The buyer cannot assess a seller or landing page
reach_proxy: Official data reports substantial social-media scam exposure
decision: Rejected because detection is crowded and false-positive risk is high

candidate: Discharge document to family care plan
target_user: Family caregivers after a hospital discharge
trigger: Medication follow-up warnings and assignments are scattered
decision: Deferred because health privacy and interpretation risk are high

target_user: Privately insured households facing a denial
trigger: A denial arrives and the user does not know whether or how to appeal
reach_proxy: Independent research reports consequential treatment denials
decision: Rejected as first product because direct competitors and medical risk are substantial
